content: Invoice Ninja (self-hostable, ELv2, Laravel+Flutter+React): 200k+ businesses. Invoicing features: 4 free/11 paid templates branded with logo+colors, real-time PDF preview as you build, product library that auto-populates line items, customizable invoice fields (company/client/columns), fully customizable invoice designs, per-line-item tax (inclusive/exclusive/VAT/GST), auto US sales tax, multiple currencies+languages, quotes that auto-convert to invoices on approval with client signature, recurring invoices/auto-billing, deposits & partial payments, auto late fees, custom payment instructions, reports/aging/statements/P&L, inventory levels per product, client portal with custom domain, attach files to invoices. Tax settings per line item or invoice total.
